precepts.text: No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; new wine, the new covenant in Christ, must be put into new bottles, new men and women born again, and both are preserved. No man having drunk old wine straightway desireth new, for he saith, the old is better. The Pharisees were not ready for animal sacrifice to be replaced by Christ, and so it is today: our people love their old traditions and do not want the new covenant of keeping the commandments.
precepts.point: For fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people and flee to his own land: a time of nationalism, and the interracial stuff ends because it is not of the Lord. Israel is a scattered sheep; Assyria devoured the northern kingdom and Nebuchadrezzar broke his bones; I will punish the king of Babylon as I punished the king of Assyria. In those days the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none, and the sins of Judah shall not be found, for I will pardon them whom I reserve. That did not happen under Cyrus, when Ezra and Nehemiah found interracial marriages; it is future. Romans 8:1, no condemnation to them in Christ; Revelation 14:5, without fault before the throne; Micah 7:19, he will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea; Isaiah 14:1, the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will yet choose Israel, in the midst of our sin, and nobody has anything to say about it. He is not pardoning all nations.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

precepts.why:
“My people hath been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.” The shepherds, the pastors, lead our people from one religion to another, and they have forgotten their restingplace, the word of God. Pastors charged with rape and child abuse, a pastor arrested on counts of rape of girls thirteen and fifteen, two pastors charged in the murder for hire of a blind, mentally disabled man for insurance money: that is how the shepherds have caused them to go astray. Yet Christians do not want to change, just as the Pharisees did not want to change.

Christ told them a parable: “No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.” Christ is the piece of new garment; the new covenant was being ushered in and they were not ready for it. It agreed not with the old covenant: animal sacrifice was replaced by the sacrifice of Christ.

“And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish. But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved.” The new wine is the new covenant in Christ. The new bottles are us being born again: new creatures, new men, new women.

“No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.” That is how the Pharisees and scribes felt about Christ's teaching, and so it is today with Christians and the true teaching of Christ and the Israelites. Our people like their old ways and old traditions, and when we bring them the new covenant in Christ by keeping the commandments, they say, I don't want that. So “their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against the Lord, the habitation of justice, even the Lord, the hope of their fathers.”

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

precepts.why:
Jeremiah 50 ends with the hammer of the whole earth broken: “Therefore hear ye the counsel of the Lord, that he hath taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out”. The least of the flock is the so-called Israelis, that tiny speck in the midst of the brown and black nations. They bomb Qatar during peace talks, cry help us, and America comes to their rescue. “surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them”: America desolate, and little Israel over there wiped out too. “At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.”

Then chapter 51 turns to us: “For Israel hath not been forsaken, nor Judah of his God, of the Lord of hosts”. That means us. It might seem like we have been forsaken because we are down and out, at the bottom. But Israel has not been forsaken, because of the covenant the Lord made with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, and he sent his Son Christ to die for our sins.

“though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel.” Even in the midst of our sin he has not forsaken us. That is the same mercy the class read in Isaiah 14:1, the Lord will have mercy on Jacob and will yet choose Israel, and nobody has anything to say about it. He is not having mercy on all nations or pardoning all nations; while Babylon, the hammer, is broken, Israel and Judah are kept.

note.label: America: Hammer of the Earth

precepts.why:
“How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised!” Sheshach is another name for Babylon. America is the praise of the whole earth; everybody has God bless America. “how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!” All the nations will be shocked when she goes down.

“The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.” The sea is the nations. Ezekiel says it: “will cause many nations to come up against thee, as the sea causeth his waves to come up.” “Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwelleth, neither doth any son of man pass thereby.” That has not happened yet; it is yet to come.

“And I will punish Bel in Babylon”. Bel was a false god, and the Bel of today is Cesare Borgia, the god of Babylon. “and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him”: in Daniel 2 the last kingdom was a mix of all nations, and that is America. God will put an end to that. “yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.”

“My people, go ye out of the midst of her, and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the Lord.” Revelation 18:4 says the same: come out of her, that ye be not partakers of her sins and receive not of her plagues, those nuclear bombs. Come out of Christmas, Easter, Kwanzaa, Memorial Day and all the foolishness done here, and return to the one true God by keeping his commandments.

“And lest your heart faint, and ye fear for the rumour”. Do not give up. A rumour is something heard and talked about that has not occurred yet: World War III and Armageddon are the rumour now, the wars and rumours of wars of Matthew 24:6. Then “violence in the land, ruler against ruler.” “Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north”, as the whole earth breaks forth into singing in Isaiah 14:7. “As Babylon hath caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.”

Everything Babylon does, everything Trump is doing on the earth today, is because the Lord wants it done. “that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine”. That wine is oppression, affliction, falsehood, lies and deceit: the same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to make all nations drink.

“therefore the nations are mad.” Europe, China, Russia, Iran, the Arab nations, Venezuela: they are angry. That is the cup, and Venezuela will not be the only one to drink it; even if they do not want to, the Lord will make them drink.

That is why the hammer will be greatly despised and broken. This is the beginning of sorrows; the world has changed and it is not going to get better. Prepare your mind and your spirit, and stop being caught up in sin.

In Jeremiah 49 the counsel is taken against Edom; here the same counsel is taken against Babylon. Edom is America, and Babylon is America. In Jeremiah 49 it is purposed against the inhabitants of Teman, and here against the land of the Chaldeans: that is Amalek, Israel.

That is the proof that Edom and Babylon are one: the treacherous dealer who deals treacherously and the spoiler who spoils in Isaiah 21 is America, the Edom and Babylon of these two prophecies, and the Lord’s counsel stands against it and against Amalek with it.

Jeremiah's word is “against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America; the Chaldeans are Amalek, so-called Israel. And it is not just Esau: it is judgment on all the nations. “Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all ye that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she hath sinned against the Lord.” “for it is the vengeance of the Lord: take vengeance upon her; as she hath done, do unto her.”

Joel shows who is called up to do it: “Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up”. The Gentiles are the other nations, and the Lord wants them to prepare war. China, America, Russia, Syria, France, Great Britain, Iran, Saudi Arabia: they all have to go to war. All you military men, wake up. It is time to go to Armageddon.

“Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.” Make weapons; you finished boot camp, now go to war. “Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.” Wake up, Esau; wake up, Ishmael. The valley of Jehoshaphat is the valley of decision, and they have to go there and die.

“Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe”; “for their wickedness is great. Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.” The nations arrayed against Babylon are the sword of the Lord bringing his vengeance on her.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
“The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.” A narrow-minded person thinks only of the fields, but look at the economic and resource oppression on the continents where we reside: both kingdoms, all twelve tribes, suffering the same afflictions. They hold us fast because of the resources in our lands.

Isaiah describes that same people: “But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.” Robbed and spoiled is the same as the oppression we read of in Micah.

Robbed goes to our identity, not only our resources. The thesaurus lays it out: cut off, deprived, destitute, dispossessed; and because we are not living as the sons of God, we accept what they call us, Gentiles, and become impoverished, without hope, without a redeemer, without access to our own resources, stripped. Spoiled, in the sense meant here, is being severely damaged or harmed in a way that reduces value: marred or ruined. We are the sons of God, the greatest people the Lord ever created, for whom he made the whole earth, and that is not what we reap now.

“none delivereth”, “none saith, Restore”: that is why our Redeemer must come and do it. “Their Redeemer is strong; the Lord of hosts is his name”, and that Redeemer is Christ. Notice all the re- words with Israel: redeemed, restored, redemption. They show the covenant never passed on to some strangers or foreign nation. Our people have got to wake up.

Solomon gives the picture of it: “There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, as an error which proceedeth from the ruler: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.”

Folly is set in great dignity: the foolish things, the vessels of wrath, raised up high. And the rich sit in low place: the real rich, the ones the Lord speaks to in Revelation, knowing their poverty and their sufferings, yet calling them rich. Israel is rich, yet sits low.

“I have seen servants upon horses, and princes walking as servants upon the earth.” Those who were meant to serve us are in positions of authority and high value, and the princes, the sons of God, walk as servants upon the earth. If that's not the visual for spoiled when you read robbed and spoiled, nothing is.

That is the oppression of Jeremiah 50:33: Israel and Judah held fast by those who took them captive. And that is why none can restore it but the Redeemer who will plead their cause and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

precepts.why:
“For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.” He comes as a whirlwind, with chariots, and his rebuke is with fire. Read on: “For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh”.

Now go back to Jeremiah 50:35 and you can visualize the sword: “A sword is upon the Chaldeans, saith the Lord, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.” The Chaldeans are the elite of the Babylonians, but it is not just the upper echelon. It is all the inhabitants of Babylon, including the Israelites that do not repent.

The sword is “upon their horses, and upon their chariots”: their tanks and planes. It is “upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her”. Is this not the great melting pot, full of thick clay heaped upon itself with all types of nations? “a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.” What they did to us will happen to them.

It is “the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols”: crazy for their idols, from the money to the structure in DC to Christianity to Americanism and the flag they wave everywhere. The fire and the sword of the Lord in Isaiah 66 is the judgment coming upon that Babylon.

note.label: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the sword upon Babylon ends in this: “it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation. As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, saith the Lord; so shall no man abide there”. Once the smoke and smoulder of the nuclear destruction is there, only wild beasts will be able to dwell there.

Isaiah says the same thing and tells you who it is: “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah. It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation”. The glory of kingdoms tells you who this is.

That is the key point. Did Sodom and Gomorrah exist after that? No. That did not happen to the physical Babylon at that time. It got some of these judgments as other empires came up over it, but it was never wiped out like Sodom. So either the Bible is lying and the prophecy did not come true, or it is talking about something else, for a different time.

It is speaking of Babylon the great today, the glory of kingdoms, the one full of mingled people and mad upon its idols: the United States. Her ultimate destruction will be as Sodom and Gomorrah.
